title: StreetWide points document (world format 0.1)
description: The content of an asset in the vegetation or street_objects layer: the points of one source in one tile. See rfcs/0004-point-features.md sections 3 and 4. Rules JSON Schema cannot state are enforced by op_world and tools/worldfmt: points sorted by id without duplicates, one source for every point, estimated attributes sorted, not null and each with a rule, and rules that name only what some point estimates; and, against the asset's manifest, kinds in the asset's layer, the feature id's source, and bounds_mm equal to the anchors' bounds.

points.description: 1 to 65,536 points, sorted by id in byte order, without duplicates.

rules.description: For each kind, its estimated attributes and the id of the rule that set each. It names nothing that no point estimates, and is {} when nothing is estimated. In format 0.1 only a light's yaw may be estimated.

pointId.description: The source's own id, {source}:{local id}: the local id is printable ASCII without spaces or colons, never lowercased or trimmed.

ruleId.description: The id of a rule that sets estimated values, defined in a decision record: adr-<4 digits>:<name>:<version>, e.g. adr-0015:yaw-from-orientierung:1.

anchor_mm.description: The ground at the object's position, relative to the tile origin. Never estimated.

estimated.description: The attributes a rule set rather than the source: sorted and unique.

treeAttributes.description: A tree, anchored at the base of its trunk. Lengths in integer millimetres; null means unknown.

species.description: A Latin binomial: a genus, then one or more words, each after a single space.

taxon.description: The source's full scientific name, with any cultivar.

lightAttributes.description: A light point as lighting data records it. Lengths in integer millimetres; null means unknown.

yaw.description: Where the head or arm points, in 1/65536 of a turn clockwise from north.
